issues.title: Can not drag the 'Item' panel down when the pointer is higher than 'Add' filter button
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Can not drag the 'Item' panel down when the pointer is higher than 'Add' filter button

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Drag the 'Items' panel is on top of left panel

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/e60541a8-ea0e-4b5c-9965-23f83ab187fd)

4. Drag the 'Item' panel down
5. Notice when pointer is higher than 'Add' filter button, seem we can't change position of 'Item' panel

View below screencast for more details

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Enable to drag the 'Item' panel down when the pointer is higher than 'Add' filter button

## 🖥️ Screenshocasts

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/af5aee6b-7aea-46f1-8165-be65534cbf4a



## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
